actions.name: Gore
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +8, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 18 (2d12 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the gorgon moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Petrifying Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. _First Failure:_ The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. _Second Failure:_ The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

bonusActions.name: Trample
bonusActions.text: _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. _Failure:_ 16 (2d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. _Success:_ Half damage. ## Gray Ooze
